Description: Specially designed rounds for use with anti-aircraft batteries.
Standard ammunition for anti-aircraft machine guns.

A large, deadly bomber capable of delivering high volumes of explosive payloads. While the V-1 Tzykalia requires a proficient bombardier crew, this Velian-made aircraft has an infamous reputation overseas on the Katoma front. Facing minimal air-to-air resistance, a full squadron of Tzykalias led by seasoned captain and ace lodesman Calliope Bibas erased a large Estrellan fortress in the desert region of Sorra Blava off the map. This operation left Alliance presence in the west reeling, furthering Republic ambitions in the region.

A Nevish bomber that was developed in direct response to a lack of aerial heavy explosive support during Alliance operations. Having been repeatedly waylaid by Tzykalia bombers along the Sorovian coast, it became clear that the Sky Brigade needed to improve their armada. The Brigade commissioned a light and fuel-efficient bomber still capable of deploying catastrophic payloads.

This unique dive bomber quickly deposits small payloads with more precision than its larger, less mobile counterparts. Bombing first and asking questions later, “Myrmidons” often lead larger bombing operations. Its effective hit-and-run tactics soften larger targets or clear out emplacements that may pose a threat to less manoeuvrable aircraft or incoming convoys.

The Toxot-902 is a modern variant of the first warplane to ever see combat; it tears across battlefields laying down strafing machine gun support but excels in air-to-air dogfights. Easy to manufacture and field in large numbers, “Blind Silvers” often give the impression of a volley of arrows soaring overhead.

The backbone of the Alliance Sky Brigade, the Harbinger excels at both strafing ground targets and dogfighting with its twin, front-facing machine guns. Not willing to be outclassed by crude Mesean engineering, Luminary—formerly a northern Caoivish industrial engineering firm—set to work on designing its Mk. I prototype. Sleek, aerodynamic, and so fast it screams, the Harbinger’s design is intended to give the Nevish Alliance a psychological edge on the battlefield as much as it provides air support.

A handful of these Velian-made aircraft are capable of depositing entire platoons of Colonial paratroopers deep behind Warden lines. In fact, these selfsame paratroopers are feared throughout the north for their commitment to night diving and opening their chute late enough that even an observant enemy might blink and miss their descent. While most paratroopers have a short lifespan, one trio that called themselves “The Furies” successfully completed over one hundred combat jumps into Caoivish territory. It’s believed The Furies are responsible for sabotaging countless Warden operations in the north and played a pivotal role in Legate Thea Maro’s “Operation Sunfall.”

A recent addition to the Alliance Sky Brigade, the Zealot is a first-of-its-kind dropship out of Sorovia. Its large fuselage and cargo bay facilitate transporting entire paratrooper units and dropping them into the fray with ease. The Zealot is best paired with escorts, as it doesn’t boast much in the way of firepower, but once it deploys a retinue of Cloudrunners, it circles back to base to load up the next squad.

Inspired by passenger seaplanes, the A51 is an extremely proficient scout plane. Dubbed “The Daedalus” by countless crews for its intrepid design, pontoons and foldable wheels give the flexibility to land, refuel, or observe enemy movements under various conditions unrivalled by more conventional aircraft.

The Mk. IV is a lighter Luminary aircraft designed for high and low-altitude intelligence gathering. Living up to its namesake, the Herald has been instrumental in thwarting several Colonial operations in the west. What it lacks in resilience and firepower, it more than makes up for in flexibility.

The M925 Edellian bomber is the Alliance Sky Brigade’s ace at air-to-sea combat. Featuring twin torpedo bays and a rear-mounted machine gun, the Man-O-War is a veritable threat to any ship’s hull or would-be assailants. The M925's unique capabilities overdelivered, as it was originally conceived as nothing more than a short-range coastal defence bomber. During the M925’s first operation off of the Katoman coast, a small squadron single-handedly sank a Titan. Her crew had no idea how their ship filled with seawater as torpedo after torpedo bored into the underside of her hull.

This unique Nevish fighter was specially designed to be launched from Mercy-class aircraft carriers, with the flexibility to operate in different environments. Fitted with several front-facing armaments, the White Raven is known to swarm enemy armadas out of nowhere. They soon find themselves careening out of the clouds.

DescriptionLocales.pt: Os especialistas Warden precisam de um uniforme projetado para otimizar sua capacidade de transportar uma variedade de munições pesadas.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Специалистам Варденов необходима форма, улучшающая возможности по перемещению различного тяжёлого вооружения.
DescriptionLocales.zh: Warden的特殊作战人员需要一套能够优化对多种重型弹药的携行能力的制服。

Description: This early O’Brien variant, the V.101 Freeman is fitted with a 360 degree ballistics cannon turret at the expense of top speed.

DescriptionLocales.de: Bei dem V.101 Freeman handelt es sich um die neueste Ausführung des O'Brien und diese ist mit einem 360 Grad rotierbarem Panzerturm ausgestattet. Jedoch leidet unter dessen Gewicht die Höchstgeschwindigkeit.
DescriptionLocales.en: This early O’Brien variant, the V.101 Freeman is fitted with a 360 degree ballistics cannon turret at the expense of top speed.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Cette variante précoce de l'O'Brien, le V.101 Freeman, est équipée d'une tourelle à canon balistique de 360 degrés au détriment de la vitesse de pointe.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Esta é a variante inicial do O'Brien, o V.101 Freeman é equipado com uma torreta com duas metralhadoras que podem girar 360 ​​graus.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Этот ранний вариант O’Brien, V.101 Freeman оснащен 360-градусной баллистической пушкой в ущерб максимальной скорости.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 作为早期的 O'Brien 变体，V.101 Freeman 牺牲了最高速度以换取一座全向的40毫米炮塔。

ChassisNameLocales.pt: Plataforma blindada de lançamento de foguetes

Description: The second full iteration of Conor O’Brien’s storied Armoured Car designs, the Squire serves as a reinforced rocket platform. The squire—designed to play a support role for larger assault operations with its rocket battery platform—is easy to reposition and provides operators and nearby infantry with more protection than might be afforded by a standard utility vehicle.

DescriptionLocales.en: The second full iteration of Conor O’Brien’s storied Armoured Car designs, the Squire serves as a reinforced rocket platform. The squire—designed to play a support role for larger assault operations with its rocket battery platform—is easy to reposition and provides operators and nearby infantry with more protection than might be afforded by a standard utility vehicle.
DescriptionLocales.fr: La seconde itération complète des illustres modèles de Voitures Blindés de Conor O’Brien, la Squire sert de plate-forme de roquettes renforcée. La squire—conçue pour jouer un rôle de soutien pour les plus grandes opérations d'assaut avec sa plate-forme de batterie de roquettes—est facile à repositionner et fournit aux opérateurs et à l'infanterie à proximité plus de protection qu'aurait été accordé à un véhicule utilitaire standard.
DescriptionLocales.pt: A segunda iteração completa dos ilustres projetos de Carros Blindados de Conor O'Brien, o Squire serve como uma plataforma de foguetes reforçada. Projetado para desempenhar um papel de apoio em operações de assalto de maior porte com sua plataforma de bateria de foguetes, o Squire é fácil de reposicionar e oferece aos operadores e à infantaria próxima mais proteção do que a oferecida por um veículo utilitário padrão.
DescriptionLocales.zh: Squire是一款加固型的火箭平台载具，是Conor O’Brien的传奇装甲车设计的第二代完整版本。它专为在大型突击行动中担任支援型的角色而设计，它搭载着火箭发射平台且易于快速机动，相对于标准的功能性载具它为操作者和附近的步兵提供了更高的防护能力。

Description: One of Conor O’Brien’s best traits was his ability to modernize and make use of older technology in his designs. The V.190 Knave is the perfect example of this philosophy. Fitted with a modified, outdated twin-grenade launcher turret, the Knave is a surprising combination of speed and subterfuge that quickly routs the enemy, leaving them befuddled.

DescriptionLocales.de: Eine der besten Eigenschaften von Conor O’Brien war seine Fähigkeit, ältere Technologien in seinen Entwürfen zu modernisieren und zu nutzen. Der V.190 "Knave" ist das perfekte Beispiel für diese Philosophie. Ausgestattet mit einem zwar veralteten aber modifizierten Doppel-Granatwerferturm ist der "Knave" eine überraschende Kombination aus Geschwindigkeit und List, die den Feind schnell in die Flucht schlägt und oder zersträut zurücklässt.
DescriptionLocales.en: One of Conor O’Brien’s best traits was his ability to modernize and make use of older technology in his designs. The V.190 Knave is the perfect example of this philosophy. Fitted with a modified, outdated twin-grenade launcher turret, the Knave is a surprising combination of speed and subterfuge that quickly routs the enemy, leaving them befuddled.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Une des meilleures qualité de Conor O’Brien était sa capacité à moderniser et faire usage d'anciennes technologies dans ses conceptions. Le V.190 Knave est le parfait exemple de cette philisophie. Équipé d'une tourelle lance-grenades jumelé archaïque, le Knave est une combinaison surprenant de vitesse et subterfuge qui met rapidement en déroute l'ennemie, le laissant confus.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Uma das melhores características de Conor O’Brien foi sua capacidade de modernizar e ao mesmo tempo poder utilizar tecnologias mais antigas em seu projeto. O V.190 Knave é o exemplo perfeito desta capacidade. Equipado com uma antiga torreta modificada de lançamento duplo de granadas, o Knave é uma combinação surpreendente de velocidade e subterfúgio que derrota rapidamente o inimigo, deixando-o confuso.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Одной из лучших черт Conor O’Brien была его способность модернизировать и использовать старые технологии в своих проектах. V.190 Knave является прекрасным примером этой философии. Оснащенный модифицированной, устаревшей башней с двумя гранатометами, Knave представляет собой удивительное сочетание скорости и хитрости, которое быстро разгромляет врага, оставляя его в замешательстве.
DescriptionLocales.zh: Conor O’Brien’s最大的特点之一就是他有着能够在设计中将旧技术实现现代化的能力。V.190 Knave就是这一哲学的完美范例。Knave配备了一门经过改装的老式双联装榴弹发射塔，它是速度和诡计的惊人组合，能够在敌人还在不知所措时迅速将他们击溃。

Description: A slight variation of the V.110, the Gravekeeper comes fitted with an embedded Bonesaw launcher, transforming the humble armoured car into an effective indirect anti-armour vehicle.

DescriptionLocales.de: Eine leicht modifizierte Ausführung des V.110, der "Gravekeeper" ist mit einem eingebetteten Bonesaw Granatwerfer ausgestattet, welcher den ansonsten PA-zahmen Panzerwagen in ein nützliches indirektes Panzerabwehrfahrzeug verwandelt.
DescriptionLocales.en: A slight variation of the V.110, the Gravekeeper comes fitted with an embedded Bonesaw launcher, transforming the humble armoured car into an effective indirect anti-armour vehicle.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Une légère variation du V.110, le "Gravekeeper" est équipé d'un lance-roquette "Bonesaw" embarqué, transformant cette humble voiture blindée en un véhicule anti-char efficace.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Uma variação do V.110, o Gravekeeper vem equipado com um lançador Bonesaw no lugar da metralhadora, transformando o humilde carro blindado em uma ferramenta efetiva contra veículos e veículos blindados.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Измененный вариант V.110, Gravekeeper оснащен встроенной установкой Bonesaw, превращающей бронеавтомобиль в эффективного борца с танками противника.
DescriptionLocales.zh: V.110型号的变体，Gravekeeper 配备了一门嵌入式的 Bonesaw 发射器，将不起眼的装甲车转变为有效的曲射反装甲载具。

Description: Colonial Armoured Cars are quick, well-rounded urban assault platforms. These anti-infantry vehicles are equipped with twin-barrelled machineguns.

DescriptionLocales.de: Panzerwagen der Colonials, sind schnelle vielseitige Fahrzeuge, die für den Orts- und Häuserkampf geeignet sind. Diese Anti-Infanterie Fahrzeuge sind mit doppelläufigen Sturmgewehren ausgestattet.
DescriptionLocales.en: Colonial Armoured Cars are quick, well-rounded urban assault platforms. These anti-infantry vehicles are equipped with twin-barrelled machineguns.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Les Voitures Blindées Coloniales sont des véhicules de combat urbain rapides et équilibrés. Ces modèles anti-infanterie sont munis de mitrailleuses jumelées.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Os Carros Blindados Colonial são plataformas de assalto urbano e rápidos. Esses veículos anti-infantaria são equipados com metralhadoras de dois canos.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Бронеавтомобили Колонистов — это быстрые, хорошо оснащенные городские штурмовые платформы. Эти противопехотные машины оснащены спаренными пулеметами.
DescriptionLocales.zh: Colonial的装甲车是快速且全面的城区突击武器平台。这类反步兵载具配备了双管机枪。

Description: While the Noble Firebrand Mk. XVII is a deadly flamethrower tank, a more efficient means of employing flame weapons was needed. Enter the Wild Jack. Named for the fiery idols made by children for Dead Harvest, the Wild Jack is a variation of the Highlander.

DescriptionLocales.de: Der Noble Firebrand Mk. XVII ist zwar ein tödlicher Flammenwerferpanzer, aber es wurde ein effizienteres Mittel für den Einsatz von Flammenwaffen benötigt. Hier kommt der Wild Jack. Benannt nach den von Kindern für Dead Harvest gefertigten Feueridolen, ist der Wild Jack eine Variante des Highlanders.
DescriptionLocales.en: While the Noble Firebrand Mk. XVII is a deadly flamethrower tank, a more efficient means of employing flame weapons was needed. Enter the Wild Jack. Named for the fiery idols made by children for Dead Harvest, the Wild Jack is a variation of the Highlander.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Bien que le Noble Firebrand Mk. XVII soit un char lance-flammes dévastateur, il fallait un moyen plus efficace pour employer des armes incendiaires. C'est ainsi qu'est né le Wild Jack. Nommé d'après les idoles enflammées fabriquées par les enfants pour Dead Harvest, le Wild Jack est une variante du Highlander.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Enquanto o caça tanques Noble Firebrand Mk. XVII é um tanque lança-chamas mortal, era necessário um meio mais barato e eficiente de empregar armas lança-chamas. Apresentamos o Wild Jack, nomeado em homenagem aos ídolos ardentes feitos por crianças para a Dead Harvest, o Wild Jack é uma variação do Highlander.
DescriptionLocales.ru: В то время как величественный Firebrand Mk. XVII - смертоносный огнеметный танк, требовалось более эффективное средство применения огнеметного оружия. Войдите в Дикого Джека. Названный в честь огненных идолов, созданных детьми для Жатвы Смерти, Дикий Джек является разновидностью Highlander.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 虽然Noble Firebrand Mk. XVII是一种致命的喷火坦克，但需要一种更有效的使用火焰武器的方法。Wild Jack就这样诞生了。Wild Jack以孩子们为Dead Harvest制作的燃烧偶像为名，是Highlander的一个变种。

Description: Fitted with all-terrain treads, the Highlander brings significant all-terrain mobility and performs especially well in snowy and mountainous environments.

DescriptionLocales.de: Ausgestattet mit Geländeketten bringt der Highlander eine erhebliche Geländegängigkeit mit sich und eignet sich hervorragend für den Gebrauch in schneebedeckten und bergigen Landschaften.
DescriptionLocales.en: Fitted with all-terrain treads, the Highlander brings significant all-terrain mobility and performs especially well in snowy and mountainous environments.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Équipé de bandes de roulement tout-terrain, le Highlander apporte une grande mobilité tout-terrain et se comporte particulièrement bien dans les environnements enneigés et montagneux.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Montado com esteiras para locomoção em terreno difícil, o Highlander traz mobilidade significante e tem bom desempenho em ambientes nevados e montanhosos.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Хайлэндер, оснащенный вездеходными гусеницами, обеспечивает значительную проходимость по бездорожью и особенно хорошо работает в заснеженных и горных условиях.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 装备了全地形适应履带的 Highlander 展现出了卓越的全地形机动性，在雪地和山地环境中表现尤为突出。

Description: This “Xiphos” variant is fitted with a high-powered anti-tank turret in place of the twin machine gun platform.

DescriptionLocales.de: Diese "Xiphos"-Variante ist, anstelle des üblichen doppelläufigen Sturmgewehrs, mit einem leistungsfähigen Panzerabwehrgeschütz ausgestattet.
DescriptionLocales.en: This “Xiphos” variant is fitted with a high-powered anti-tank turret in place of the twin machine gun platform.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Cette variante du "Xiphos" est équipée d'une tourelle antichar très puissante à la place de la plate-forme à mitrailleuses jumelées.
DescriptionLocales.pt: A variante "Xiphos" é equipada com um poderoso canhão antitanque no lugar da plataforma de metralhadora dupla.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Этот вариант «Xiphos» оснащен довольно мощной противотанковой пушкой вместо спаренного пулемета.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 这种“Xiphos”变种配备了一个大威力反坦克步枪以取代双管机枪。

Description: Fitted with twin RPG launchers, the T8 employs hit-and-run assaults against enemy structures and emplacements.

DescriptionLocales.de: Mit zwei Raketenwerfern ausgestattet ist der T8 bestens dazu geeignet, mit immer wiederkehrenden zermürbenden Überfallangriffen, auf feindliche Gebäude oder Befestigungen zu wirken.
DescriptionLocales.en: Fitted with twin RPG launchers, the T8 employs hit-and-run assaults against enemy structures and emplacements.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Équipé d'un double lanceur RPG, le T8 excelle dans les attaques éclairs contre les structures et les emplacements ennemis.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Equipado com duplo lançadores de RPG, o T8 emprega ataques de relâmpagos contra estruturas e armas fixas inimigas.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Оснащенный спаренной пусковой установкой РПГ, T8 может атаковать вражеские сооружения и огневые позиции методом «бей и беги».
DescriptionLocales.zh: 装备着两具火箭筒，T8装甲车常用打带跑的游击战术突袭敌方建筑与工事。

Description: Warden Armoured Cars are quick, well-rounded urban assault platforms. These anti-infantry vehicles are equipped with twin-barrelled machineguns.

DescriptionLocales.de: Panzerwagen der Wardens, sind schnelle vielseitige Fahrzeuge, die für den Orts- und Häuserkampf geeignet sind. Diese Anti-Infanterie Fahrzeuge sind mit doppelläufigen Sturmgewehren ausgestattet.
DescriptionLocales.en: Warden Armoured Cars are quick, well-rounded urban assault platforms. These anti-infantry vehicles are equipped with twin-barrelled machineguns.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Les voitures blindées Warden sont des véhicules de combat urbain bien rodés. Ces modèles anti-infanterie sont munies de mitrailleuses jumelles.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Os Carros Blindados Warden são plataformas rápidas e versáteis de assalto urbano. Estes veículos anti-infantaria são equipados com metralhadoras de cano duplo.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Бронеавтомобиль Варденов — быстрая бронированая машина для ведения городских боев. Этот противопехотный автомобиль оснащен спаренным пулемётом.
DescriptionLocales.zh: Warden基础型装甲车作为搭载了双管机枪的反步兵载具，是一种快速且全面的巷战突击平台。

Description: A heavily reinforced vest designed to protect grenadiers from back blasts. As such, the Flak Vest reduces cuts and scrapes on top of dampening bullet impacts.

DescriptionLocales.de: Eine schwer verstärkte Weste, die entworfen wurde, um Grenadiere vor Schrapnellen zu schützen. Aus diesem Grund ist die Flak Weste dazu geeignet, die Anzahl an Schnitten und Kratzern zu verringern, während sie außerdem die Wucht von Projektilen reduziert.
DescriptionLocales.en: A heavily reinforced vest designed to protect grenadiers from back blasts. As such, the Flak Vest reduces cuts and scrapes on top of dampening bullet impacts.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Un gilet lourdement renforcé conçu pour protéger les grenadiers des souffles arrière. En tant que tel, le gilet réduit les éclats et échardes en plus d'amortir les impacts des balles.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Um colete fortemente reforçado projetado para proteger granadeiros de explosões de estilhaços. Como tal, o Flak Vest reduz cortes e arranhões e ainda reduz o dano de impactos de projeteis leves a média e longa distancia.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Тяжело усиленный жилет, предназначенный для защиты гренадеров от струй реактивных газов. По итогу, бронежилет также уменьшает порезы и царапины в дополнение к гашению энергии пуль.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 一件强化加固的防弹背心，旨在保护掷弹兵免受破片爆炸伤害，也可以在抑制子弹冲击的同时减少割伤和擦伤。

Description: Repurposed from ancient wars, these armour plates are highly effective at stopping enemy small arms fire. That protection comes at the cost of weight, and the wearer will feel quite restricted and encumbered.

DescriptionLocales.de: Diese, aus alten Kriegen stammenden, Plattenpanzer wurden zu einer Grabenrüstung umfunktioniert, die auch sehr effektiv darin ist kleinkalibrigen Beschuss abzufangen. Dieser extra Schutz kommt leider mit einem hohen Gewicht einher und schränkt den Träger deutlich ein.
DescriptionLocales.en: Repurposed from ancient wars, these armour plates are highly effective at stopping enemy small arms fire. That protection comes at the cost of weight, and the wearer will feel quite restricted and encumbered.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Ces cuirasses, qui proviennent d'anciennes guerres, sont très efficaces pour arrêter les tirs d'armes légères de l'ennemi. Cette protection se fait au prix d'un certain poids, et le porteur se sentira assez limité et encombré.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Armadura reaproveitada de guerras antigas, essas placas de blindagem são altamente eficazes em absorver projéteis de armas pequenas. Esse aumento na proteção resulta no aumento do peso, o usuário estará bem pesado e com pouco inventário em seu uniforme.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Перепрофилированные с древних войн, эти доспехи очень эффективны против мелкокалиберного огня. Защита достается ценой тяжести: надевший будет ощущать себя довольно скованным и нагруженным.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 从古代战争的造物中改装而来的这些装甲板在防范敌军轻武器火力上非常有效。但是这种保护是以重量为代价，并且穿戴者会感到行动颇为受阻。

Description: Standard ammunition for Storm Rifles and Armoured Cars.

DescriptionLocales.de: Standardmunition für Sturmgewehre und Panzerwagen.
DescriptionLocales.en: Standard ammunition for Storm Rifles and Armoured Cars.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Munitions standard pour les Fusils d'Assaut et les Voitures Blindées.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Munição padrão para Storm Rifles e Carros Blindados.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Стандартные боеприпасы для штурмовых винтовок и бронемашин.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 风暴步枪与装甲车使用的标准弹药。

Description: A titanic light machine gun capable of scattering infantry lines with ease, the Catara is a modern weapon for the modern Colonial.

DescriptionLocales.de: Die Catara ist ein titanisches, leichtes Maschinengewehr, das Infanterielinien mühelos durchbrechen kann und eine moderne Waffe für den modernen Colonial darstellt.
DescriptionLocales.en: A titanic light machine gun capable of scattering infantry lines with ease, the Catara is a modern weapon for the modern Colonial.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Léger, redoutable, capable de briser les lignes d'infanterie avec facilité, le fusil-mitrailleur Catara est une arme moderne pour le Colonial d'aujourd'hui.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Leve, formidável, capaz de apagar linhas de infantaria com facilidade, a metralhadora Catara é uma arma moderna para o Colonial moderno.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Легкий ручной пулемет, способный быстро расправиться с пехотой противника. Catara — передовое оружие для современных Colonial.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 一种能够轻松打散敌军防线的大型轻机枪，“Catara”是一款为现代Colonial打造的现代武器。

Description: This unique assault rifle includes a high-capacity drum magazine designed for sustained rapid fire.

DescriptionLocales.de: Dieses einzigartige Sturmgewehr zeichnet sich durch ein großes Trommelmagazin aus, das für anhaltendes Schnellfeuer ausgelegt ist.
DescriptionLocales.en: This unique assault rifle includes a high-capacity drum magazine designed for sustained rapid fire.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Ce Fusil d'Assaut unique possède un chargeur tambour à haute capacité pensé pour un feu nourri en continu.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Esse rifle de assalto único possui um tambor de munição de alta capacidade projetado para fogo rápido contínuo.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Эта универсальная штурмовая винтовка включает в себя барабанный магазин для ведения продолжительного быстрого огня.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 这种独特的突击步枪配有一个高容量的弹鼓以满足连续高速射击的需求。

Description: The Booker is a high-impact three-round burst Storm Rifle for those who like to shoot first.

DescriptionLocales.de: Das Booker ist ein schlagkräftiges Feuerstoß Sturmgewehr für all Diejenigen, die gerne mal zuerst schießen.
DescriptionLocales.en: The Booker is a high-impact three-round burst Storm Rifle for those who like to shoot first.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Le Booker est un fusil d'assaut à fort impact tirant en rafales de 3 coups pour ceux qui aiment tirer en premier.
DescriptionLocales.pt: O 'Booker' é um Storm Rifle de alto impacto com rajadas de três tiros para aqueles que gostam de atirar primeiro.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Букер — это Штурмовая Винтовка с очередью из трех выстрелов, для тех, кто любит стрелять первым.
DescriptionLocales.zh: Booker是一种拥有高压制力的三连发风暴步枪，受那些喜欢先发制人的士兵喜爱。

Description: Widely considered to be the first storm rifle, the Aalto is a marvel in Caoivish engineering. With its two fire modes, it can be used as a rapid-fire assault weapon or a mid-range rifle.

DescriptionLocales.de: Das Aalto gilt weithin als das erste Sturmgewehr überhaupt und ist zudem ein Wunderwerk des Caovischen Ingenieurwesens. Mit seinen zwei Feuermodus kann es als Schnellfeuer-Sturmgewehr oder als Mittelstreckengewehr dienen.
DescriptionLocales.en: Widely considered to be the first storm rifle, the Aalto is a marvel in Caoivish engineering. With its two fire modes, it can be used as a rapid-fire assault weapon or a mid-range rifle.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Reconnu comme le premier fusil d'assaut, l'Aalto est une prouesse de l'ingénierie Caoivish. Avec ses deux modes de tir, il peut être utilisé comme arme d'assaut à tir rapide ou comme fusil à moyenne portée.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Amplamente considerada o primeiro fuzil de assalto, a Aalto é uma maravilha em engenharia Caoivish. Possuindo dois modos de tiro, esta maravilha pode ser usada como um fuzil automatico ou um rifle de médio alcance preciso.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Считающийся первой штурмовой винтовкой, Aalto является чудом Caoivish инженерной мысли. С двумя режимами стрельбы, он может быть использован как скорострельный автомат, или же как винтовка для средних дистанций.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 作为被公认为是首个风暴步枪的武器， Aalto 是Caoivish工程学的奇迹。它的两种射击模式使其可以同时被用作高射速突击武器和中程步枪。

DescriptionLocales.de: Ein explosiver Kolben, dessen Inhalt sich mit Leichtigkeit durch Panzerung brennt. Diese mit Bedacht entworfene "Flüssigbombe" explodiert beim Aufprall in einen spektakulären Feuerball aus geschmolzenen Trümmern.
DescriptionLocales.en: An explosive flask used for melting enemy armour. This carefully designed liquid bomb explodes into a dazzling flash of molten debris upon impact.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Une fiole explosive utilisée pour faire fondre les blindages ennemis. Cette bombe liquide soigneusement conçue explose en un flash éblouissant de débris en fusion à l'impact.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Um frasco explosivo usado para derreter blindagem inimiga. Essa bomba líquida feita com cuidado explode em um clarão de fragmentos derretidos no impacto.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Взрывная фляга используется для нейтрализации вражеской бронетехники. Тщательно разработанная жидкая бомба взрывается ослепительной вспышкой раскаленных осколков при ударе.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 一种用于融化敌方装甲的烧瓶型爆炸物。这种精心设计的液体炸弹在撞击时会爆炸成令人眼花缭乱的熔融碎片。

Description: A compact anti-tank grenade that can be fired from rifle grenade launcher attachments or grenade turrets. Its dense payload excels at crippling armoured vehicles while being versatile and easy to transport.

DescriptionLocales.de: Eine kompakte Panzerabwehrgranate, die als Gewehrgranate oder aus Granatwerfertürmen abgefeuert werden kann. Ihre Sprengladung eignet sich hervorragend zum Vernichten gepanzerter Fahrzeuge, während sie gleichzeitig vielseitig und leicht zu transportieren ist.
DescriptionLocales.en: A compact anti-tank grenade that can be fired from rifle grenade launcher attachments or grenade turrets. Its dense payload excels at crippling armoured vehicles while being versatile and easy to transport.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Une grenade antichar compacte qui peut être tiré depuis les attachements lance-grenades pour fusils et les tourelles lance-grenades. Sa charge dense excelle pour mutiler les véhicules blindés tout en étant versatile et facile à transporter.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Uma granada antitanque compacta que pode ser disparada de acessórios de lançadores de granadas de rifle ou torres de granadas. Sua carga útil densa é excelente para incapacitar veículos blindados, sendo versátil e fácil de transportar.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Компактная противотанковая граната для стрельбы из дульного гранатомета винтовки или турели. Её заряд отлично подходит для обездвиживания бронетехники, а сама граната универсальна и удобна в транспортировке.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 一种紧凑型反坦克手榴弹，可以从步枪的榴弹发射器附件或榴弹炮塔发射。其大密度的炸药擅长于瘫痪装甲车，同时也功能多样且易于运输。

Description: While the Satterley is designed to be operated by a single infantryman, it remains a cumbersome rifle due to its heavy kickback and burst fire configuration. This heavy burst rifle is best suited for small squads to blindside enemy armour, stripping steel with ease, but its cumbersome setup makes it less than ideal for infantry skirmishes.

DescriptionLocales.en: While the Satterley is designed to be operated by a single infantryman, it remains a cumbersome rifle due to its heavy kickback and burst fire configuration. This heavy burst rifle is best suited for small squads to blindside enemy armour, stripping steel with ease, but its cumbersome setup makes it less than ideal for infantry skirmishes.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Bien que le Satterley soit conçu pour être utilisé par un seul fantassin, il reste un fusil encombrant à cause de son important recul et son mode de tir en rafale. Ce fusil lourd à rafale est mieux adapté aux petites escouades afin de surprendre les blindés ennemis, décapant l'acier avec aise, mais son utilisation encombrante ne le rend pas idéal pour les escarmouches d'infanterie.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Embora o Satterley seja projetado para ser operado por um único soldado de infantaria, ele continua sendo um rifle desajeitado devido ao seu recuo pesado e configuração de tiro em rajada. Este rifle pesado é mais adequado para pequenos esquadrões com o objetivo de atacar blindados inimigos, removendo o blindagem com facilidade. Seu proposito e peso o tornam menos que ideal para combate de infantaria.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Satterley - противотанковое ружье с режимом стрельбы с отсечкой по 2 выстрела, которое несмотря на свой громоздкий размер и сильную отдачу рассчитано на использование одним человеком. Оно отлично подходит для засады на технику, с легкостью пробивая сталь, однако ввиду своего размера, не предназначено для стычек с пехотой противника.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 虽然Satterley的设计用于单兵操作，但由于其强大的后坐力和连发配置，它仍然是一支笨重的步枪。这种重型爆炸开火式步枪最适合小分队用于干扰敌方装甲力量，并轻松剥离装甲，但其笨重的配置使其不太适合小规模的步兵战斗。

Description: A variant of the Booker Storm Rifle, the Greyhound boasts a larger overall receiver and barrel to accommodate the increased stopping power of anti-tank rounds. Its longer, bulkier barrel allows for increased range. As a heavier automatic rifle, the Greyhound remains an excellent tool for those who’d prefer to shoot before asking questions.

DescriptionLocales.en: A variant of the Booker Storm Rifle, the Greyhound boasts a larger overall receiver and barrel to accommodate the increased stopping power of anti-tank rounds. Its longer, bulkier barrel allows for increased range. As a heavier automatic rifle, the Greyhound remains an excellent tool for those who’d prefer to shoot before asking questions.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Une variante du Fusil d'Assaut Booker, le Greyhound peut se vanter d'un châssis et canon globalement plus gros pour supporter le pouvoir d'arrêt accru des balles antichars. Son canon plus long est volumineux permet une portée accrue. En tant que fusil automatique plus lourd, le Greyhound reste un excellent outil pour ceux qui préfèrerait tirer avant de pauser des questions.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Uma variante do Booker Storm Rifle, o Greyhound ostenta uma caixa da culatra e cano maiores para acomodar o poder de parada aumentado de munições antitanque maiores. Seu cano mais longo e volumoso permite maior alcance. Como um rifle automático mais pesado, o Greyhound continua sendo uma excelente ferramenta para aqueles que preferem atirar antes de fazer perguntas.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Greyhound - вариация штурмовой винтовки Booker с увеличенной ствольной коробкой под противотанковые боеприпасы. Обладает удлиненным стволом, увеличивающим дальность стрельбы. Оставаясь при этом автоматической винтовкой, Greyhound является прекрасным инструментом для тех, кто предпочитает стрелять прежде, чем спрашивать.
DescriptionLocales.zh: Greyhound步枪是Booker风暴步枪的一种变体，它拥有更大的整体接收器和枪管，以适应反坦克弹药增加的制动能力。其更长、更笨重的枪管增加了射程。即便作为一种较重的自动步枪，Greyhound也是那些喜欢先发制人的士兵的绝佳工具。

Description: A three-round burst anti-tank rifle with a high-capacity magazine. Built from a modified “Dusk” assault rifle, the receiver has been altered to support top-loaded drum magazines for better stability and efficient loading to account for its more cumbersome design and higher calibre rounds.

DescriptionLocales.en: A three-round burst anti-tank rifle with a high-capacity magazine. Built from a modified “Dusk” assault rifle, the receiver has been altered to support top-loaded drum magazines for better stability and efficient loading to account for its more cumbersome design and higher calibre rounds.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Un fusil antichar à rafale à trois coups avec un chargeur grande capacité. Fabriqué à partir d'un fusil d'assaut "Dusk" modifié, le châssis a été changé pour supporter des chargeurs à tambour chargés par le haut pour une meilleure stabilité et un rechargement plus efficace pour s'adapter à son design plus encombrant et ses balles de plus gros calibres.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Um rifle antitanque que dispara três tiros em cadência com um carregador de alta capacidade. Construído a partir de um rifle de assalto "Dusk" modificado, o receptor foi alterado para suportar carregadores de tambor de carregamento superior para melhor estabilidade e carregamento eficiente para compensar seu design mais pesado e cartuchos de calibre mais alto.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Противотанковое ружье с режимом стрельбы с отсечкой по 3 выстрела и магазином большой вместимости. Собрана из модифицированной штурмовой винтовки "Dusk". Ствольная коробка была изменена под барабанный магазин с верхней подачей для лучшей стабильности и удобного заряжания, чтобы компенсировать громоздкую конструкцию и больший калибр.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 一种带有大容量弹匣的三连发爆炸开火反坦克步枪。该款枪支由改进的“Dusk”突击步枪制成，经过改装，可以支撑它顶部装载的鼓形弹匣，能够获得更好的稳定性和有效的弹容量，以适配其更笨重的设计和更高口径的子弹。

Description: A deadly, long-range sniper rifle with exceptional stopping power. The “Quickhatch” is a gluttonous firearm that hungers for enemy armour and flesh alike.

DescriptionLocales.en: A deadly, long-range sniper rifle with exceptional stopping power. The “Quickhatch” is a gluttonous firearm that hungers for enemy armour and flesh alike.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Un fusil de précision létal à longue portée avec un pouvoir d'arrêt exceptionnel. Le "Quickhatch" est une arme à feu gloutonne qui a soif de blindage ennemi et de chair.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Um rifle sniper mortal de longo alcance com poder de parada excepcional. O “Quickhatch” é uma arma de fogo glutona que sente fome de armadura e carne inimiga.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Смертоносная длинноствольная снайперская винтовка с исключительным останавливающим действием. Quickhatch прекрасно подходит как для охоты на броню, так и на солдат противника.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 一种具有出色的制动能力的致命远程狙击步枪。“Quickhatch”是一种暴食的枪支，钟爱于啃食敌人的装甲和血肉。

Description: This mounted anti-tank rifle boasts improved accuracy over its free-standing counterparts. The Typhon was specifically designed with shock absorption in mind, allowing for faster, more consistent firing patterns.

DescriptionLocales.de: Diese montierte Panzerbüchse bietet bessere Genauigkeit zu seinen frei stehenden Gegenstücken. Die Typhon wurde mit dem Gedanken der Rückstoß-Absorbierung entworfen. Dies erlaubt deutlich schnellere und längere Feuerstöße.
DescriptionLocales.en: This mounted anti-tank rifle boasts improved accuracy over its free-standing counterparts. The Typhon was specifically designed with shock absorption in mind, allowing for faster, more consistent firing patterns.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Ce fusil antichar monté offre une précision accrue par rapport à ses homologues autonomes. Le Typhon a été spécialement conçu pour absorber les chocs, ce qui permet des tirs plus rapides et plus réguliers.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Esta arma anti-tanque de 20 mm montada possui precisão superior em relação às suas contrapartes que não necessitam ser montadas. O Typhon foi projetado especificamente com a absorção de choque em mente, permitindo disparos mais rápidos e consistentes.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Это станковое противотанковое ружье может похвастаться высокой точностью, превосходя тем самым своих конкурентов. Обладая специальной амортизационной системой, Typhon может вести быстрый и продолжительный огонь.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 这种架设式反坦克步枪相比它的可动式竞争者拥有更高的精度。 Typhon 的设计考虑到了减震需求，可以运用更快、更精准的射击方式。

DescriptionLocales.pt: O Neville é incomparável em sua versatilidade como uma arma 20 mm portátil anti-blindagem.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Neville 20мм ПТ ружье не имеющих себе равных в универсальности и портативности.
DescriptionLocales.zh: Neville 作为一种便携的弹匣式反装甲武器，拥有着无可比拟的功能性。

DescriptionLocales.en: The Venom RPG launcher fires anti-tank charges. Its simple design makes it easy to deploy, even in high-stakes operations.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Le lanceur de RPG Venom tire des charges antichars. Sa conception simple le rend facile à déployer, même dans les opérations à fort enjeu.
DescriptionLocales.pt: O lançador RPG "Venom" dispara projéteis antitanque. Seu design simples o torna simples de ser utilizado, mesmo em operações de alto risco.
DescriptionLocales.ru: РПГ Venom стреляет противотанковыми снарядами. Простая конструкция делает его удобным в использовании даже во время рискованных операций.
DescriptionLocales.zh: “Venom”火箭筒可发射反坦克弹药，简洁的设计使其即使在高风险行动中也易于部署使用。

Description: This shoulder-mounted heavy launcher is the first of its kind. It features heavy blast shielding and is capable of launching anti-tank charges over relatively large distances.

DescriptionLocales.de: Dieser schwere schultergestütze Raketenwerfer ist der erste seiner Art. Er bietet einen Schild zum Schutz vor Explosionen und ist dazu fähig Panzerabwehr Geschosse über recht weite Entfernungen abzufeuern.
DescriptionLocales.en: This shoulder-mounted heavy launcher is the first of its kind. It features heavy blast shielding and is capable of launching anti-tank charges over relatively large distances.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Ce lanceur lourd, à porter sur l'épaule, est le premier du genre. Il dispose d'un blindage anti-souffle lourd et est capable de lancer des charges antichars sur des distances relativement grandes.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Este lançador pesado de ombro é o primeiro do seu tipo. Possui escudo protetor e consegue lançar munições antitanque à distâncias relativamente longas.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Эта переносная тяжелая пусковая установка является первой в своем роде. Её особенность в наличии защитного экрана от пороховых газов, образующихся при выстреле, а также возможность запускать противотанковые снаряды на относительно большие дистанции.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 这种肩扛式重型发射器是同类武器的先驱。它装有重型防爆护板，能够在相对较长的距离外发射反坦克弹头。

Description: Allows infantry to bombard armoured vehicles from safe distances. This anti-tank rocket launcher is surprisingly light when compared to its contemporaries. Its weight is a double-edged sword, as firing heavy anti-tank ordinance requires a Carnyx operator to prepare for heavy recoil.

DescriptionLocales.en: Allows infantry to bombard armoured vehicles from safe distances. This anti-tank rocket launcher is surprisingly light when compared to its contemporaries. Its weight is a double-edged sword, as firing heavy anti-tank ordinance requires a Carnyx operator to prepare for heavy recoil.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Permets à l'infanterie de bombarder les véhicules blindés depuis des distances sûres. Ce lance-roquettes antichar est étonnamment léger comparé à ces contemporains. Son poids est une arme à double tranchant puisque tirer des munitions antichars lourdes nécessite que l'utilisateur du Carnyx se prépare à un fort recul.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Permite que a infantaria atire em veículos blindados a distâncias seguras. Este lançador de foguetes antitanque é surpreendentemente leve em comparação com seus contemporâneos. Seu peso é uma faca de dois gumes, pois disparar munição antitanque pesada exige que o usuário do Carnyx esteja preparado para um forte recuo.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Позволяет пехоте обстреливать бронетехнику с безопасного расстояния. Эта РПГ на удивление легкая по сравнению с ее современниками. Ее вес — палка о двух концах, поскольку стрельба тяжелыми противотанковыми боеприпасами требует от оператора Carnyx подготовки к сильной отдаче.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 允许步兵从安全的距离爆破装甲载具。这款反坦克火箭发射器比起它同时期的产物来说出奇的轻。但这种重量上的优势也是一把双刃剑，因为发射重型反坦克炮弹需要Carnyx的操作人员能够应对它强大的反冲力。

DescriptionLocales.en: This single-use rocket can be fired a short distance. Designed to punch holes into tanks, the Ignifist is the perfect tool for infantry anticipating armoured resistance.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Cette roquette à usage unique se tire à courte distance. Conçue pour transpercer les chars, l'Ignifist est l'outil idéal pour l'infanterie qui anticipe une résistance blindée.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Esse foguete de uso único pode ser atirado de uma distância curta. Feito para furar tanques, o Ignifist é a ferramenta perfeita para infantaria que antecipa resistência de veículos blindados.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Однозарядная ракета малой дальности. Ignifist - это превосходный инструмент для пехоты, позволяющий эффективно сражаться против бронированной техники противника.
DescriptionLocales.zh: Ignifist 是一种被设计用来给对方坦克上开个洞的短距离一次性火箭，是步兵对抗装甲部队的完美工具。

DescriptionLocales.en: This variant of the Bonesaw MK.3 is specially designed for use with tripod mounts. This affords it with increased stability and maximum potential range.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Cette variante du "Bonesaw MK.3" est spécialement conçue pour être utilisée avec un trépied. Cela lui confère une stabilité accrue et une portée effective maximale.

DescriptionLocales.zh: 这具 Bonesaw MK.3 的变体型号被设计安装在三脚架上，增加了它的稳定性与最大射程。

Description: The pride of the Warden anti-armour arsenal, the Bonesaw MK.3 has one job: to cut through the heavy metal plating of Colonial tanks.

DescriptionLocales.de: Der Stolz des Panzerabwehr-Arsenals der Wardens. Der Bonesaw MK.3 hat nur eine Aufgabe: Mit seiner Munition die schwere Panzerung der Colonial Panzer zu durchdringen.
DescriptionLocales.en: The pride of the Warden anti-armour arsenal, the Bonesaw MK.3 has one job: to cut through the heavy metal plating of Colonial tanks.
DescriptionLocales.fr: La fierté de l'arsenal antichar Warden, le Bonesaw MK.3 n'a qu'un but : pénétrer le blindage lourd des tanks Coloniaux.
DescriptionLocales.pt: O orgulho do arsenal antitanque Warden, a Bonesaw MK.3 tem uma tarefa: Penetrar a blindagem pesada Colonial.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Гордость противотанкового арсенала Варденов, у Bonesaw MK.3 одна работа: прорезать насквозь тяжелую броню колонистких танков.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 作为 Warden 反装甲武器中的骄傲， Bonesaw MK.3 只有一个使命：击穿 Colonial 坦克的重型金属装甲。

Description: Used to stem bleeding.

DescriptionLocales.de: Wird benutzt, um eine Blutung zu stoppen.
DescriptionLocales.en: Used to stem bleeding.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Utilisé pour arrêter les saignements.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Usada para estancar sangramentos.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Используется для остановки кровотечения.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 用于止血。

Description: To plant a Vexillum of the Colonial Legion is to claim victory for the Mesean Republic. For the End is Our Glory.

DescriptionLocales.de: Ein Vexillum der Colonial Legion zu setzen bedeutet, den Sieg für die Mesean Republic zu erringen. Denn das Ende ist unser Ruhm.
DescriptionLocales.en: To plant a Vexillum of the Colonial Legion is to claim victory for the Mesean Republic. For the End is Our Glory.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Planter un Vexillum de la Légion Coloniale c'est déclarer victoire pour la République Méséanne. Car la Fin est Notre Gloire.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Fincar um Vexillum da Legião Colonial é declarar vitória para a República Mesean. Pois o Fim é a Nossa Glória.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Установить флаг Колонистов — значит провозгласить победу Месейской республики. Ибо конец, это наша слава.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 将Colonial军团的旌旗插在阵地上就是宣称Mesean共和国的胜利。最终能留下的，只有我们的荣耀。

Description: The Warden Ensign is a death mark for Caoiva’s enemies. Those who choose to ignore our warning will find that their bravery is misguided.

DescriptionLocales.de: Die Warden Standarte ist ein Todeszeichen für die Feinde Caoivas. Diejenigen, die unsere Warnung ignorieren, werden feststellen, dass ihre Tapferkeit fehlgeleitet ist.
DescriptionLocales.en: The Warden Ensign is a death mark for Caoiva’s enemies. Those who choose to ignore our warning will find that their bravery is misguided.
DescriptionLocales.fr: L'Étendard Warden est une marque de mort pour les ennemies de Caoiva. Ceux qui choisissent d'ignorer notre avertissement découvriront que leur bravoure est malavisée.
DescriptionLocales.pt: O Estandarte Warden é a marca da certeza de morte para os invasores de Caoiva. Aqueles que escolherem ignorar nosso aviso descobrirão que sua bravura é equivocada.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Флаг Варденов — смертельная метка для врагов Каоивы. Те, кто решит проигнорировать наше предупреждение, обнаружат, что их храбрость была напрасной.
DescriptionLocales.zh: Warden的战旗对Caoiva的敌人来说是死亡的象征。那些选择忽视我们警告的人将会知道他们的蛮力进攻只是误入歧途。

Description: Used to construct Barbed Wire defenses.

DescriptionLocales.de: Wird verwendet, um Verteidigungsanlagen aus Stacheldraht zu bauen.
DescriptionLocales.en: Used to construct Barbed Wire defenses.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Utilisé pour construire des défenses en Fil Barbelé.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Usado para construir defesas de arame farpado.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Используется для возведения укрытий из колючий проволоки.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 用于建造铁丝网防御工事。

Description: A large shipping vessel, the Aquatipper is used to transport vehicles, equipment, and personnel over large bodies of water.

DescriptionLocales.de: Bei dem Aquatipper handelt es sich um einen größeren Lastkahn, der zum Transport von Fahrzeugen, Ausrüstung und Personen über größere Gewässer genutzt wird.
DescriptionLocales.en: A large shipping vessel, the Aquatipper is used to transport vehicles, equipment, and personnel over large bodies of water.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Grand navire de transport, l'Aquatipper est utilisé pour transporter des véhicules, des équipements et du personnel sur de grandes étendues d'eau.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Uma grande barcaça de transporte, o Aquatipper é usado para transportar veículos, equipamentos e pessoal sobre a água.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Большое транспортное судно Aquatipper используется для перевозки, транспорта, снаряжения и пехоты на большие морские пространства.

Description: In response to the Legion embarking on aggressive northern offensives, the Firebrand is designed to conflagrate and eradicate their garrisons with ease. Built using the aggressive frame of the Widow, the Firebrand is a pure force of nature when paired with a secondary armoured escort.

DescriptionLocales.de: Als Reaktion auf die aggressive nördliche Offensive der Legion ist die "Firebrand" darauf ausgelegt feindliche Garnisonen mit Leichtigkeit abzufackeln und einzuäschern. Die "Firebrand" wurde unter Wiederverwendung des aggressiven Rahmens der "Widow" konzipiert und ist eine reine Naturgewalt, wenn sie z. B. von einer gepanzerten Panzer-Eskorte unterstützt wird.
DescriptionLocales.en: In response to the Legion embarking on aggressive northern offensives, the Firebrand is designed to conflagrate and eradicate their garrisons with ease. Built using the aggressive frame of the Widow, the Firebrand is a pure force of nature when paired with a secondary armoured escort.
DescriptionLocales.fr: En réponse aux offensives agressives de la Légion vers le nord, le Firebrand a été conçu pour incendier et éliminer facilement leurs garnisons. Reprenant le châssis offensif du Widow, le Firebrand est une arme puissante lorsqu'il est accompagné d'une escorte blindée.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Em resposta para a Legião embarcando em ofensivas agressivas ao norte, a Fireband é projetada para conflagrar e erradicar suas guarnições com facilidade. Construída usando o corpo da Widow, a Firebrand é uma pura força da natureza quando junta com uma escolta secundária blindada.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Созданный в ответ на агрессивное наступление Легиона на северном направлении, Firebrand может без труда выжигать гарнизоны противника. Вкупе с танковой поддержкой, Firebrand, построенный на усиленном шасси Widow, представляет собой пример сокрушительной мощи природной стихии.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 为了应对军团发动的北方侵略攻势，Firebrand应运而生并用于轻松地烧尽敌人的驻军。Firebrand采用了Widow的侵略性框架底盘。有了副装甲的加持，Firebrand可以被称为纯粹的自然力量。

Description: This deadly tank turns predator into prey. A tank Destroyer, the Noble Widow specializes in ambush tactics, waiting for its quarry and striking with destructive high-velocity shells.

DescriptionLocales.de: Dieser mächtige Panzer verwandelt den Jäger in Beute. Als Panzerschreck eignet sich der "Noble Widow" hervorragend für Hinterhalte. Auf seine Beute lauernd, bis er sie dann letztendlich dank seiner Hochgeschwindigkeits-Munition zum Erliegen bringt.
DescriptionLocales.en: This deadly tank turns predator into prey. A tank Destroyer, the Noble Widow specializes in ambush tactics, waiting for its quarry and striking with destructive high-velocity shells.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Ce char meurtrier transforme n'importe que prédateur en proie. Le Noble Widow, destructeur de chars, est spécialisé en tactiques d'embuscade, attendant sa proie et la frappant d'obus ravageurs à haute vélocité.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Esse mortífero tanque torna predadores em presa. O caça-tanques Noble Widow se especializa em táticas de emboscada, esperando pelo seu adversário e o punindo com sua poderosa munição de alta-velocidade.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Этот смертоносный танк превращает охотника в добычу. Истребитель танков Noble Widow специализируется на засадных тактиках, ожидая свою добычу и разрывая ее разрушающими скоростными снарядами.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 这个致命的坦克能使捕食者变成猎物。作为坦克歼击车， “Noble Widow” 擅长伏击战术，等待它的猎物上钩，并用毁灭性的高初速炮弹对其进行打击。

DescriptionLocales.zh: 用于驱动所有载具和资源矿机的普通燃料。

Description: Specialized payloads for use with dive bomber aircraft.

A sturdy, stationary cannon for bombarding high-flying enemy aircraft with explosive shrapnel shells. The DAE 5b anti-aircraft emplacement has become infamous for walls of black smoke its payload leaves behind.

A late entry into the Leary arsenal, the AA-70 Bolas was a direct response to a sudden uptick in Colonial aerial aggression. This emplaced cannon excels equally at both slowing and bringing down enemy aircraft.

Built to compliment other free-standing artillery pieces, the emplaced Huber Starbreaker launches 94.5mm shells over very long distances. A necessary tool for infantry to knock back armoured Colonial advances.

DescriptionLocales.de: Der stationierbare Huber Starbreaker wurde als Ergänzung zu anderen freistehenden Artilleriegeschützen gebaut und feuert 94,5mm Panzerabwehrgranaten auf relativ große Entfernung ab. Ein notwendiges Werkzeug für die Infanterie, um gepanzerte Colonial Vorstöße zurückzuschlagen.
DescriptionLocales.en: Built to compliment other free-standing artillery pieces, the emplaced Huber Starbreaker launches 94.5mm shells over very long distances. A necessary tool for infantry to knock back armoured Colonial advances.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Construit pour complémenter des pièces d'artilleries autonomes, le Huber Starbreaker fixe tire des obus de 94,5 mm sur de très longues distances. Un outil nécessaire à l'infanterie pour contrer les avancées blindées Colonial.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Construído para complementar outras armas antitanques independentes, a arma estacionária Huber Starbreaker dispara projéteis de 94,5 mm em distâncias muito longas. Uma ferramenta necessária para a infantaria repelir os avanços de colunas blindadas Coloniais.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Созданный в дополнение к другим автономным артиллерийским установкам, установленный Huber Starbreaker запускает 94,5-мм снаряды на очень большие расстояния. Необходимый инструмент для пехоты, чтобы отбросить бронированные наступления Colonial.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 为了配合其他独立火炮而设计，架设后的Huber Starbreaker能在极远的距离外发射94.5mm炮弹。对步兵来说是击退Colonial装甲攻势的必要工具。

Description: A defensive emplacement with a 68mm Anti-tank cannon. This rudimentary weapon was once built to fit onto the hull of large naval vessels, but was eventually phased out and repurposed.

DescriptionLocales.de: Eine Verteidigungsstellung mit einer 68mm Panzerabwehrkanone. Diese rudimentäre Waffe wurde einst gebaut, um auf dem Rumpf großer Marineschiffe zu passen, wurde aber schließlich ausgemustert und umfunktioniert.
DescriptionLocales.en: A defensive emplacement with a 68mm Anti-tank cannon. This rudimentary weapon was once built to fit onto the hull of large naval vessels, but was eventually phased out and repurposed.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Un emplacement défensif avec un canon antichar de 68 mm. Cette arme rudimentaire fut jadis construite pour être installée sur la coque de navires de guerre, mais fut progressivement supprimée et reconvertie.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Uma posição defensiva com um canhão antitanque de 68 mm. Esta arma rudimentar já foi construída para caber no casco de poderosos navios de guerra, mas acabou sendo aposentada e reaproveitada.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Оборонительное сооружение с 68-мм противотанковой пушкой. Это рудиментарное оружие когда-то было сконструировано для установки на корпус больших военно-морских судов, но в конечном итоге было снято с производства и перепрофилировано.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 一款放置性的防御用68毫米反坦克炮。这个简陋的武器最初被用于安装在大型军舰的船体上，但最终被淘汰并找到了新的用途。

Description: Not to be outdone by its counterparts, the 2a-1 “Ruptura” is fitted with a 75mm cannon. Designed to aid in holding ground for longer durations, the “Ruptura” is a strong, efficient anti-armour tool.

DescriptionLocales.de: Um von seinen Gegenstücken nicht übertroffen zu werden, ist die 2a-1 "Ruptura" mit einer 75mm Kanone ausgestattet. Die "Ruptura" ist ein starkes und effizientes Panzerabwehr-Werkzeug, das entwickelt wurde, um dabei zu helfen, die Stellung für längere Zeit zu halten.
DescriptionLocales.en: Not to be outdone by its counterparts, the 2a-1 “Ruptura” is fitted with a 75mm cannon. Designed to aid in holding ground for longer durations, the “Ruptura” is a strong, efficient anti-armour tool.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Pour ne pas être en reste par rapport à son homologue, le 2a-1 "Ruptura" est équipé d'un canon de 75 mm. Conçu pour aider à tenir du terrain pour de plus longues durées, le "Ruptura" est un outil anti-blindé puissant et efficace.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Para não ficar atrás dos seus homólogos, a 2a-1 “Ruptura” está equipado com um canhão de 75 mm. Projetada para ajudar a manter o terreno por períodos mais longos, a “Ruptura” é uma ferramenta forte e eficiente.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Чтобы не отставать от своих аналогов, 2a-1 “Ruptura” оснащена 75-мм пушкой. Разработанный для того, чтобы помочь удерживать позиции в течение более длительного времени, “Ruptura” является прочным и эффективным средством защиты от брони.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 2a-1“Ruptura”也不甘示弱于它的竞争对手，配备了一门75毫米加农炮。“Ruptura”是一种坚固、高效的反装甲工具，设计用于帮助长时间地守住阵地。

Description: This heavy artillery cannon is designed to cripple enemy fortifications from an entrenched position. Its long heavy barrel gives the "Thunderbolt" outstanding range.

DescriptionLocales.de: Dieses schwere Artilleriegeschütz wurde entworfen, um feindliche Befestigungen aus sicherer Stellung zu zerstören. Ihr langer und schwerer Lauf gibt der "Thunderbolt" eine hervorragende Reichweite.
DescriptionLocales.en: This heavy artillery cannon is designed to cripple enemy fortifications from an entrenched position. Its long heavy barrel gives the "Thunderbolt" outstanding range.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Ce canon d'artillerie lourde est conçu pour neutraliser les fortifications ennemies depuis une position retranchée. Son long canon lourd confère au "Thunderbolt" une portée exceptionnelle.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Este canhão de artilharia pesada foi desenvolvido para destruir fortificações inimigas a partir de uma posição entrincheirada. O seu longo cano dá ao "Thunderbolt" um alcance incrível.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Это тяжелое артиллерийское орудие предназначено для уничтожения вражеских укреплений с закрытых позиций. Длинный и мощный ствол придает «Thunderbolt» выдающуюся дальность стрельбы.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 这种重型火炮的设计目的是从一个防守稳固的位置重创敌方的防御工事。长而重的炮管给予了“Thunderbolt”杰出的射程。

Description: A heavy cannon designed to shatter the garrisons and fortifications of advancing forces. The Exalt is best utilized when emplaced into a defensive position to take advantage of its impressive range.

DescriptionLocales.de: Ein schweres Geschütz, das entworfen wurde, um vorgelagerte feindliche Befestigungen zu zerstören. Das Exalt ist am effektivsten, wenn es in einer Verteidigungsanlage eingebettet ist, um dann seine volle Reichweite ausnutzen zu können.
DescriptionLocales.en: A heavy cannon designed to shatter the garrisons and fortifications of advancing forces. The Exalt is best utilized when emplaced into a defensive position to take advantage of its impressive range.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Un canon lourd conçu pour briser les garnisons et les fortifications des forces qui avancent. L'Exalt est mieux utilisé lorsqu'il est placé dans une position défensive pour profiter de son impressionnante portée.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Uma artilharia pesada projetada para destruir as guarnições e fortificações. A Exalt é melhor utilizada quando colocada em uma posição defensiva para aproveitar seu alcance impressionante.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Тяжелое орудие разработанное для разрушения гарнизонов и фортификаций надвигающихся сил. Exalt лучше всего применима, находясь в оборонительной позиции, используя ее впечатляющую дальнобойность.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 一种旨在粉碎进攻部队的守备部队和防御工事的重型榴弹炮。当它被架设到防御性位置时，可以发挥它令人印象深刻的射程。

ChassisNameLocales.ru: Стационарное РПГ для стрельбы по навесной траектории (ARC)

Description: To combat Caoivish ingenuity, the Meseans developed their own indirect RPG propulsion system. Dual launchers are fitted on a large emplacement platform to maximize coverage in an established position, rather than being relegated to a guerrilla warfare tool.

DescriptionLocales.de: Um den Einfallsreichtum der Caoivish etwas entgegenzusetzen entwickelten die Meseaner ihr eigenes indirektes RPG-Abschusssystem. Doppelwerfer sind auf einer großen Befestigungsplattform angebracht, um damit die Wirkungsabdeckung in einer etablierten Position zu maximieren. So macht diese Schöpfung keinerlei Anstalten zu einem feigen Instrument der Guerillakriegsführung degradiert zu werden.
DescriptionLocales.en: To combat Caoivish ingenuity, the Meseans developed their own indirect RPG propulsion system. Dual launchers are fitted on a large emplacement platform to maximize coverage in an established position, rather than being relegated to a guerrilla warfare tool.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Pour combattre l'ingénuité Caoivish, les Méséens ont développé leur propre système de propulsion RPG indirect. Des lanceurs jumelés sont installés sur une grande plateforme fixe pour maximiser la protection dans une position établie, plutôt que d'être relégué à un outil de guérilla.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Para combater a engenhosidade dos Caoivish, os Meseans desenvolveram seu próprio sistema de disparo indireto de RPG. Os lançadores duplos são instalados numa grande plataforma para maximizar a cobertura numa posição estabelecida, em vez de serem relegados a uma ferramenta de guerra de guerrilha.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Чтобы бороться с изобретательностью Caoivish, Meseans разработали свою собственную двигательную установку непрямого действия для РПГ. Сдвоенные пусковые установки устанавливаются на большой огневой платформе для максимального охвата установленной позиции, вместо того, чтобы превращаются в средство ведения партизанской войны.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 为了对抗Caovish的创新武器，Mesean开发了属于自己的曲射火箭推进系统。为了最大限度地覆盖阵地的防御范围，他们将双管发射器安装在一个大型炮台上，而不是用于游击战。

Description: Built like a saw blade, the DAE 1b-2 emplacement gun is fitted with three cascading machine gun turrets. What the "Serra" lacks in power, it makes up for in sheer rate of fire for a weapon of its size.
The Snare Trap is a repurposed anti-aircraft flak cannon used to fortify emplaced positions with twin anti-infantry machine guns.

DescriptionLocales.de: Die Snare Trap ist eine umfunktionierte Flakkanone, die zur Verstärkung von Stellungen mit Zwillingsmaschinengewehren zur Infanterieabwehr eingesetzt wird.
DescriptionLocales.en: The Snare Trap is a repurposed anti-aircraft flak cannon used to fortify emplaced positions with twin anti-infantry machine guns.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Le Snare Trap est un canon anti-aérien reconverti utilisé pour fortifier des positions fixes avec des mitrailleuses jumelées anti-infanterie.
DescriptionLocales.pt: O Snare Trap é uma adaptação de um canhão antiaéreo que agora é usado para fortificar posições estacionarias com metralhadoras duplas anti-infantaria.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Snare Trap - это перепрофилированная зенитная пушка, используемая для укрепления позиций спаренными противопехотными пулеметами.
DescriptionLocales.zh: “Snare Trap”是一种重新设计的防空高射炮，它使用双管反步兵机枪来稳固阵地。

Description: A light artillery cannon designed to be a fixture in defensive fortifications. The Lariat sports a formidable long-range 120mm cannon designed to put immense pressure on enemy infantry.

DescriptionLocales.de: Ein leichtes Artilleriegeschütz, das als Teil von Verteidigungsanlagen entworfen wurde. Das Lariat hat eine beeindruckende 120mm Kanone mit langer Reichweite, entworfen um feindliche Fußsoldaten mit schwerem Beschuss einzudecken.
DescriptionLocales.en: A light artillery cannon designed to be a fixture in defensive fortifications. The Lariat sports a formidable long-range 120mm cannon designed to put immense pressure on enemy infantry.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Un canon d'artillerie légère conçu pour être une pièce maîtresse des fortifications défensives. Le Lariat est doté d'un formidable canon de 120 mm à longue portée, conçu pour exercer une pression énorme sur l'infanterie ennemie.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Um canhão leve de artilharia projetado para ser instalado em fortificações defensivas. O 'Lariat' emprega um formidável canhão de longo alcance de 120mm, projetado para impor grande pressão a infantaria inimiga.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Легкая артиллерия, предназначенная для установки в оборонительных укреплениях. Lariat оснащен грозным дальнобойным 120-мм орудием, предназначенным для сильного подавления пехоты противника.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 一种用于固定在防御工事内的轻型火炮。“Lariat”拥有一根强大的远程120毫米加农炮管，用于对敌军步兵施加巨大压力。

Description: The DAE 3b-2 fires rockets over long distances from a safe, emplaced position. This unique weapon was given its name due to the screams heard across the battlefield during its first deployment, with some referring to the barrage as a “web of death.”

DescriptionLocales.de: Die DAE 3b-2 feuert aus einer sicheren zumeist befestigten Position heraus Raketen über große Entfernungen ab. Diese einzigartige Waffe erhielt ihren Namen aufgrund der Schreckensschreie, die während ihres ersten Einsatzes auf dem Schlachtfeld zu hören waren, wobei Einige dieses Sperrfeuer auch als das Netz des Todes bezeichneten.
DescriptionLocales.en: The DAE 3b-2 fires rockets over long distances from a safe, emplaced position. This unique weapon was given its name due to the screams heard across the battlefield during its first deployment, with some referring to the barrage as a “web of death.”
DescriptionLocales.fr: Le DAE 3b-2 tire des roquettes sur de longues distances depuis une position de sécurité. Cette arme singulière a été baptisée ainsi en raison des cris entendus sur le champ de bataille lors de son premier déploiement, certains qualifiant le tir de barrage de "toile de la mort".
DescriptionLocales.pt: O DAE 3b-2 dispara foguetes a longa distância desde a segurança de uma trincheira. Esta arma única recebeu o seu nome devido aos gritos que ocorreram na batalha onde este lançador de foguetes foi utilizado pela primeira vez, alguns se referem ao bombardeamento do DAE 3b-2 como "o assobio da morte."
DescriptionLocales.ru: DAE 3b-2 способна запускать ракеты на дальние дистанции с закрытой, безопасной позиции. Эта уникальная установка получила своё название во время первого развёртывания, из-за криков, раздававшихся на поле боя; некоторые прозвали обстрел из орудия "паутиной смерти"
DescriptionLocales.zh: DAE 3b-2可从一个安全的位置远距离发射火箭。这种独特的武器名来源于它首次亮相时倾泻的被称为“死亡之网”的弹幕火力，与火箭弹划破战场上空产生的刺耳呼啸声。

Description: Engineers are the bones of the Mesean Republic. They are outfitted with a heavy bag and belts for easy access to tools and handheld materials.

DescriptionLocales.de: Die Ingenieure bilden das Rückgrat der Meseanischen Republik. Sie sind mit einer schweren Tasche und Gürteln ausgestattet, die den Zugriff auf Werkzeuge und Handgeräte erleichtern.
DescriptionLocales.en: Engineers are the bones of the Mesean Republic. They are outfitted with a heavy bag and belts for easy access to tools and handheld materials.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Les ingénieurs sont l'ossature de la République Meseane. Ils sont équipés d'un sac lourd et de ceintures pour un accès facile aux outils et aux matériaux portatifs.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Engenheiros são os pilares da República Mesean. Eles são equipados com uma mochila resiliente e bolsos que permitem um fácil acesso as suas ferramentas e materiais portáteis.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Инженеры - это костяк Mesean Republic. Они экипированы тяжелой сумкой и ремнями для легкого доступа к инструментам и подручным материалам.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 工程师是Mesean Republic的脊梁，他们为了方便取用工具和材料经常带着沉重的背包和腰带。

Description: Caoivish engineers are legendary in song and stature. They wear specialized uniforms, outfitted with belts and bags for easy access to tools and handheld materials.

DescriptionLocales.de: Die Caoivish-Ingenieure sind legendär für ihren Gesang und ihre Statur. Sie tragen spezielle Uniformen, die mit Gürteln und Taschen ausgestattet sind, um den Zugriff auf Werkzeuge und Materialien zu erleichtern.
DescriptionLocales.en: Caoivish engineers are legendary in song and stature. They wear specialized uniforms, outfitted with belts and bags for easy access to tools and handheld materials.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Les ingénieurs Caoiviens sont légendaires par leurs chants et leur stature. Ils portent des uniformes spécialisés, équipés de ceintures et de sacs pour faciliter l'accès aux outils et aux matériaux portatifs.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Engenheiros Caoivish são legendários em canções do passado e estatura. Eles vestem uniformes especializados, equipados com cintos e bolsos para acesso fácil as ferramentas e materiais de mão.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Caoivish инженеры запечатлены легендарными в песнях и статуях. Они носят специализированную форму, оснащенную ремнями и подсумками для легкого доступа к инструментам и подручным материалам.
DescriptionLocales.zh: Caoivish工兵在歌谣中已经是传奇般的存在。他们穿着配有皮带和口袋的专业制服，可快速使用工具和搬运建材。

Description: Resource used for producing explosive weapons.

DescriptionLocales.de: Ressource, die für die Produktion von explosiven Waffen bzw. explosiver Munition benutzt wird.
DescriptionLocales.en: Resource used for producing explosive weapons.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Ressource utilisée pour la production d'armes explosives.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Recurso usado para produzir armas explosivas.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Ресурс, используемый для производства взрывчатки.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 用于生产爆破武器的资源。

DamageType.DescriptionDetails: Always has a chance to breach bunkers

Description: This unique demolition tool is a long, metal tube packed with explosives. The Hydra’s Whisper is designed to destroy out-of-reach movement impairing structures and detonate any mines along the length of the tube.

Text.Text: Destroys obstacles that can otherwise only be dismantled with Wrenches

DescriptionLocales.de: Bei diesem einzigartigen Zerstörungswerkzeug handelt es sich um ein langes Metalrohr gefüllt mit Sprengstoff. Die Hydra's Whisper wurde entworfen, um schwer zugängliche, Blockaden sowie Panzerminen entlang des Sprengrohres zu beseitigen.
DescriptionLocales.en: This unique demolition tool is a long, metal tube packed with explosives. The Hydra’s Whisper is designed to destroy out-of-reach movement impairing structures and detonate any mines along the length of the tube.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Cet outil de démolition unique est un long tube métallique rempli d'explosifs. Le "Hydra’s Whisper" est conçu pour détruire les structures hors d'atteinte qui entravent les mouvements et faire exploser les mines le long du tube.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Essa ferramenta única de demolição é um longo tubo de metal preenchido com explosivos. O "Hydra's Whisper" foi desenvolvido para destruir arames-farpados e detonar minas de uma distância segura.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Этот уникальный инструмент для разрушения представляет собой длинную металлическую трубку, начиненную взрывчаткой. Hydra’s Whisper предназначен для уничтожения структур, препятствующих движению, и подрыва любых мин по всей длине трубы.
DescriptionLocales.zh: Hydra's Whisper 是一种由长金属管内填炸药组成的爆破工具，被设计用于在安全距离摧毁路障，引爆地雷。

Description: A high-powered explosive charge that requires an accompanying detonator. The Havoc Charge is highly effective at demolishing large structures. The charge must be detonated via gunshot. The Havoc Charge’s true potential is unleashed when executing strategic demolitions at safe distances.

DescriptionLocales.de: Eine leistungsstarke Sprengladung, die einen begleitenden Zünder erfordert. Die "Havoc" Explosivladung ist sehr effektiv bei der Zerstörung großer Strukturen. Die Ladung muss durch einen Schuss gezündet werden. Das wahre Potenzial der Havoc Charge wird freigesetzt, wenn strategische Sprengungen aus sicherer Entfernung ausgeführt werden.
DescriptionLocales.en: A high-powered explosive charge that requires an accompanying detonator. The Havoc Charge is highly effective at demolishing large structures. The charge must be detonated via gunshot. The Havoc Charge’s true potential is unleashed when executing strategic demolitions at safe distances.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Une charge explosive de grande puissance qui nécessite d'être accompagné d'un détonateur. La Charge Havoc est très efficace pour démolir les grandes structures. La charge doit être déclenchée par un coup de feu. Le vrai potentiel de la Charge Havoc se déchaîne lors de l'éxecution de démolitions stratégiques à des distances sûres.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Uma carga explosiva de alta potência que requer um detonador acompanhante. A Carga Havoc é altamente efetiva em demolir grandes estruturas. A carga deve ser detonada via tiros. O verdadeiro potencial da Carga Havoc é liberado ao executar demolições estratégicas a distâncias seguras.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Мощный заряд взрывчатого вещества, для которого требуется сопутствующий детонатор. Заряд Хавок очень эффективен при сносе больших строений. Заряд должен быть взорван выстрелом по нему. Истинный потенциал Хавок Заряда раскрывается при выполнении стратегических разрушений на безопасном расстоянии.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 一种需要一个配套起爆器的高能炸药。Havoc Charge在拆除大型建筑方面非常有效。其必须通过枪击引爆。只有在安全距离执行战略拆除时，Havoc Charge的真正潜力才会得到释放。

Description: Refined Coal required for various Facility processes.

DescriptionLocales.de: Raffinierte Kohle, die für verschiedene Anlagenprozesse benötigt wird.
DescriptionLocales.en: Refined Coal required for various Facility processes.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Charbon raffiné nécessaire pour divers processus aux Installations.
DescriptionLocales.pt: O Carvão Refinado é necessário para vários processos de Instalações Industriais.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Очищенный уголь, необходимый для различных производственных процессов.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 各种工业设施工艺所需的精煤。

Description: Damaged Components that can be salvaged into Components.

DescriptionLocales.de: Beschädigte Komponenten, die in Komponenten umgewandelt werden können.
DescriptionLocales.en: Damaged Components that can be salvaged into Components.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Composants endommagés qui peuvent être recyclés en Composants.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Componentes danificados que podem ser transformados em Componentes.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Поврежденные Компоненты, которые могут быть восстановлены в Компоненты.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 能够被回收成零件的受损的零件。

Description: Metal beams needed to produce basic structures, vehicles, and equipment at Facilities.

DescriptionLocales.de: Metallträger, die zur Herstellung von Grundstrukturen und Fahrzeugen in Fabrikanlagen benötigt werden.
DescriptionLocales.en: Metal beams needed to produce basic structures, vehicles, and equipment at Facilities.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Des poutrelles métalliques nécessaires pour produire des structures, véhicules, et équipements basiques à des Installations.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Vigas metálicas utilizadas na fabricação de estruturas básicas e veículos em instalações fabris.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Металлические балки, необходимые для производства основных сооружений, техники и оборудования на заводах.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 工业设施生产基础结构、载具和装备所需的金属梁。

Description: A reinforced barrel of extremely explosive substances required for the deadliest warheads.

DescriptionLocales.de: Ein verstärktes Fass mit extrem explosiven Substanzen, die für die tödlichsten Sprengköpfe benötigt werden.
DescriptionLocales.en: A reinforced barrel of extremely explosive substances required for the deadliest warheads.
DescriptionLocales.fr: Un baril renforcé de substances extrêmement explosives nécessaire pour les ogives les plus meurtrières.
DescriptionLocales.pt: Um barril reforçado com substâncias extremamente explosivas necessárias para as ogivas mais mortíferas.
DescriptionLocales.ru: Это усиленная бочка с чрезвычайно взрывчатыми веществами, необходимыми для самых смертоносных боеголовок.
DescriptionLocales.zh: 制造最致命的弹头所需的装有极易爆炸物质的加固桶。

Description: Heat-absorbant metal shielding that protects even the most volatile materials from the elements, preventing unwanted explosions.
